references.text: The command to honor father and mother, which the rebellious son breaks by disobeying his parents.
The law against striking one's father or mother, showing the seriousness of opposing parents.
A curse on anyone who curses their father or mother, related to the disobedience of the rebellious son.
Whoever curses their father or mother shall die, parallel to the punishment for the rebellious son.
The warning about the eye that mocks a father and despises obedience to a mother, a theme of disobedience to parents.
A son who acts shamefully and dishonorably toward his parents, similar to the description of the rebellious son.
Whoever steals from father or mother and says it is not sin, connected with dishonoring parents.
Jesus quotes the command to honor father and mother and criticizes those who evade their obligations to their parents.
Paul urges children to obey their parents in the Lord, referencing the command to honor father and mother.
Children are urged to obey their parents in everything, contrasting with the disobedient son in Deuteronomy.
